calibration.requirements: Fit >=100 observations of each class and >=10 positive days; assessment >=100 of each class and >=5 positive days. Retain only positive slope and non-worse second-half Brier.
calibration.limitation: The model checkpoint used full 2024 validation loss. These chronological calibration diagnostics remain development evidence, not independent validation.
calibration.reason: Retained: second-half development Brier did not worsen.

threshold_objective: Maximum binary F1 on observed first-half 2024 fit targets; higher threshold breaks exact ties.

fit_metrics.undefined_metrics_note: Recall is undefined without positive truth; precision is undefined without positive predictions; F1/IoU/CSI are undefined if their denominators are zero.

assessment_metrics.undefined_metrics_note: Recall is undefined without positive truth; precision is undefined without positive predictions; F1/IoU/CSI are undefined if their denominators are zero.

test_disclosure: 2025 was previously inspected, including the strict run. This is a new, label-statistics-selected proxy definition, not an untouched-test claim.
